title: Cherry Paella with Glace Sauce
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, featuring cherry-glazed shrimp and a sweet, sticky glace sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Spanish rice to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cherry glace to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and stir to coat with the glace sauce.
Serve immediately, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
